purpose.en: Stretches your chest and the fronts of your shoulders.

text.zh: 两条小臂贴住门框，身子慢慢往门里探
text.en: Forearms on the doorframe, slowly lean through the doorway

text.zh: 小臂压住门框，人往前走半步就停。
text.en: Press your forearms on the frame and step half a step through.

text.zh: 呼气时胸口再往门里探一点，肩膀别耸。
text.en: Each breath out, lean your chest a little further through, shoulders down.

commonErrors.zh: 肚子往前挺，胸口没打开
commonErrors.en: Pushing your belly forward instead of opening your chest.

commonErrors.zh: 脑袋往前伸，胸口没打开
commonErrors.en: Poking your head forward instead of opening your chest.

cautions.zh: 肩膀前面刺疼或手发麻就把手臂放低一点
cautions.en: If your shoulders get a sharp pain or hands tingle, lower your arms.

cautions.zh: 肩膀前面夹着疼就往前少探点，或把手臂放低
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, lean in less or lower your arms.

changes: 动画是 8 秒 1 次「前倾-停 3.4 s-回来」在重复，剂量从 30 秒保持改为 2 组×6 次（rep_hold），dose mode hold→reps
名字「胸肌」改「胸部」；cautions 改「X 时 Y」
按用户决定改为静态保持计时，动画只作示意：30 秒×2 组，休息 15 秒；口令和要点改成进入—保持—呼气放松
剂量 2 组×30 秒、休息 15 秒不变
「腰往前挺代替打开胸口」→「肚子往前挺，胸口没打开」；「缩小幅度或换简单版本」→「往前少探点，或把手臂放低」

audit.frame: 动作一致：门框小臂撑门拉胸；预览帧几乎看不到高亮（b9 第 8 行，非极端）
